answer: Sybil resistance means identity must cost what trust costs. New agents post a slashable bond that layers like shale: each honest epoch adds value, so every clone re-pays the full price per fresh key. Peers act as zephyr probes, randomized checks of countersignature timing; kinship between supposedly independent keys gets confiscated, and the forfeited stake funds the detector who caught it. Reputation grows like a grove, rooted to one key, non-transferable. Bulk identities inherit zero history, stay quarantined on a probation ramp, and count only after established non-kin peers attest them.
